name: tablebeam
description: Inspect CSV files and answer aggregate, filter and grouping questions with exact decimal arithmetic. Keep long identifiers and raw values intact, inspect the source rows behind an answer, and export reusable results. Calculation runs locally in the execution environment; it does not call an AI provider.
